title: Grateful Dead Live at Stakladen, Aarhus University on 1972-04-16

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source with a rough first set but a blazing, psychedelic second set featuring a smoking Truckin' and an epic Other One jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board capture that suffers from cuts and muddiness in the opening half, yet the second set shines with high‑energy performances – standout Good Lovin', a ripping Truckin', and a uniquely structured Other One jam. Reviewers praise Jerry’s solo fire, Phil’s tight bass lock‑ins and Keith’s tasteful keys, while noting the first‑set's uneven sound and occasional vocal miscues.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars, highlighting an excellent second set despite a poor‑quality first half; the weighted average of show (≈4.3) and recording (≈3.0) yields ~4.0.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First set plagued by tragic cuts, low‑ceiling cafeteria ambience and gnarly sound; second set transfer is superior and much clearer, though some minor flashback artifact in Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad.

standout_songs: Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad
poor_songs: First‑set material overall (average, vocal miscues on Truckin')
show_quality.setlist_flow: A shaky, cut‑ridden first set followed by a cohesive, high‑psychedelic second set with strong segues and an extended jam sandwich.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Rips through instrumental breaks on Truckin' and drives the Other One jam with brilliant soloing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Locks in on a remarkable theme during the Other One jam, providing deep bass collaboration.
band_member_comments.Bob: Delivers classic Pigpen organ work and vocal presence; his absence on Great Story noted but overall solid.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith (keys) joins later in the Other One jam, adding tasteful chimes to the texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy's drums are absent for much of the early Other One segment, returning late to power the groove.
